image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, vertical branch amidst a tangle of twigs. The bird displays the characteristic plumage of a breeding male: a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast and underparts, and black upperparts with visible white shoulder patches. The background consists of out-of-focus green foliage and brown branches, creating a natural woodland setting.
